title: Finite cohomology abutment of a filtered exact couple
statement: Let C be abelian, let S be a functor from the full subcategory of finitely decreasing-filtered cochain complexes to cohomological spectral sequences starting at 1, and let e1 give first-page isomorphisms to H^(p+q)(gr^p U) [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-spectral-sequence, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Fix U and a type-zero bigraded exact couple X [def-sp-exact-couple]. Suppose eD identifies X.D(P,Q) with H^(P+Q)(F^(-Q) U), and eC identifies X.pageCouple(s).E(2p+q,-p) with S(U).E_(s+1)^(p,q). Assume alpha corresponds via eD to filtration inclusion and initial gamma corresponds via eC at s=0 and e1 to the quotient projection on cohomology. Then there exist decreasing filtrations G on H^n(U), limiting subobjects L of X, diagonal alpha-colimits A and isomorphisms aH:A(n).obj to H^n(U) [def-sp-convergence]. The steps of G are exactly image(H^n(F^p U) to H^n(U)), and G is finite and separated. The cocone map from D(P,n-P), followed by aH, is eD followed by the cohomology inclusion from F^(P-n) U into U, with the indicated index transports. X converges to L,A in the regular, abutting and inverse-limit sense of def-sp-convergence, and its infinite page at (2p+q,-p) is isomorphic to gr^p G H^(p+q)(U). This result constructs no page functor, representative maps or finite-page differentials.

proof.text: Use filteredCohomologyDiagonal_isColimit to form the explicit alpha-colimit A(n) whose object is H^n(U). Its structure maps are filteredCohomologyDiagonalMap. Choose aH to be the identity isomorphism. The cocone compatibility in the conclusion is then the definition of the structure map.

Images of A(n).iota(P) agree with the homology inclusion images, because precomposition by the isomorphism eD and the equality transport does not change an image. Define G(n).step(p) to be imageFiltration(n,A(n)).step(p+n). Antitonicity follows by shifting its integer argument. The whole and zero steps of U give whole and zero homology images, so both the diagonal image filtration and G are finite. A bottom step implies separation and a top step implies exhaustiveness.

The explicit cocone maps are isomorphisms in the whole-step tail. The source D terms are zero in the zero-step tail, via eD and preservation of zero objects by the homology functor. Apply finiteCocone_weakConvergence to these verified bounds to obtain L, regularity, and canonical weak convergence.

A finite filtration has the required quotient inverse-limit property: choose a bottom step b, at which the cokernel projection is an isomorphism. For a compatible inverse cone f define h=f(b) followed by the inverse of this projection. Integer induction about b proves every projection equation; the downward step uses compatibility, and the upward step cancels the quotient transition, an isomorphism in the bottom tail. Uniqueness follows by cancelling the projection at b. The private finite_inverseLimit helper is fully proved. Combine this with separatedness, exhaustiveness, regularity and weak convergence to obtain ConvergesTo.

Use weakConvergence_comparison, which is already proved in ExactCoupleConvergence, and reindex the graded piece. Total degree (2p+q)+(-p)=p+q, and filtration index (2p+q)-(p+q)=p. Equality transports give the required pageInfinity-to-G graded isomorphism.
